# Philly SHRM

> The Philadelphia Society for Human Resource Management (Philly SHRM) is a professional organization serving Delaware Valley HR professionals with events, networking, and career development opportunities.

Philly SHRM is the local chapter of SHRM serving the Philadelphia and Tri-State Region. The organization hosts conferences, symposiums, awards ceremonies, and professional development workshops for HR professionals in Pennsylvania and surrounding areas.

## Key Topics

- Professional Development
- HR Professionals
- SHRM
- Networking

- [Events](https://phillyshrm.org/events): Philly SHRM events calendar for Delaware Valley HR professionals
- [Symposium](https://phillyshrm.org/events/symposium): Annual Philly SHRM Symposium at Hilton Philadelphia with SHRM PDCs
- [Live Events](https://phillyshrm.org/events/live-events-2): Upcoming live events including Delaware Valley HR Person of Year Awards
